problem_statement: The nightly high-value release run crashed again at 02:14 with `PolicyTimeout: fraud policy service timed out for order HV-88213`. The exception escapes `run_release_queue`, so every order after the one that timed out stays unprocessed until someone reruns the job by hand. The fraud policy service has short latency spikes a few times a week and we can't keep paging on-call for them. Please make the release run handle a policy-service timeout for a single order and finish cleanly, processing the rest of the queue.
